question: A bus travelling at 66 km/hr completes a journey in 15 hours. What should be its speed to cover the same distance in 5 hours?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When the distance is constant, the speed is inversely proportional to the time taken.

S₁ / S₂ = T₂ / T₁

66 / S₂ = 5 / 15

66 / S₂ = 1 / 3

S₂ = 66 × 3 = 198 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 198 km/hr.**
